cham.de_bai: Change the citation and bibliography style of the document to APA.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Lưu một bản sao tài liệu vào thư mục Documents dạng PDF tên “Pharma2026”, tối ưu cho Minimum size (publishing online). Không mở file sau khi xuất.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Save a copy of the document in your Documents folder as a PDF file named “Pharma2026” that is optimized for minimum size (publishing online). Do not open the file after publishing.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) File > Save a Copy > Browse > Documents.  2) File name: Pharma2026; Save as type: PDF (*.pdf).  3) Optimize for: chọn Minimum size (publishing online); bỏ chọn Open file after publishing > Save.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) File > Save a Copy > Browse > Documents.  2) File name: Pharma2026; Save as type: PDF (*.pdf).  3) Optimize for: Minimum size (publishing online); clear Open file after publishing > Save.

cham.de_bai: Save a copy of the document in your Documents folder as a PDF file named “Pharma2026” that is optimized for minimum size (publishing online). Do not open the file after publishing.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De05_P7_Recycle_Expert.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới. File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open De05_P7_Recycle_Expert.docx and complete the tasks below in order. Extra files (pictures, data, 3D Models) are in the same work folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Lưu style set hiện tại thành style set mới tên “RecycleStyleSet” ở vị trí mặc định.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Save the current style set as a new style set named “RecycleStyleSet” in the default location.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Design > mở gallery Style Set > Save as a New Style Set.  2) File name: RecycleStyleSet > Save (giữ thư mục QuickStyles mặc định).
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Design > open the Style Set gallery > Save as a New Style Set.  2) File name: RecycleStyleSet > Save (keep the default QuickStyles folder).

cham.de_bai: Save the current style set as a new style set named “RecycleStyleSet” in the default location.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong đoạn trống ngay dưới băng tiêu đề, chèn mục lục tùy chỉnh hiện 3 cấp tiêu đề và gồm cả các mục dùng style Subtitle ở TOC level 4.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the blank paragraph directly below the title banner, insert a custom table of contents that shows 3 heading levels and includes entries formatted with the Subtitle style at TOC level 4.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ vào đoạn trống ngay dưới banner tiêu đề.  2) References > Table of Contents > Custom Table of Contents > Show levels: 3.  3) Options… > tìm Subtitle, nhập 4 vào ô TOC level > OK > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor in the blank paragraph right below the title banner.  2) References > Table of Contents > Custom Table of Contents > Show levels: 3.  3) Options… > find Subtitle, type 4 in its TOC level box > OK > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the blank paragraph directly below the title banner, insert a custom table of contents that shows 3 heading levels and includes entries formatted with the Subtitle style at TOC level 4.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “What Cannot Be Recycled?”, tắt Widow/Orphan control cho hai đoạn văn sau tiêu đề và giữ các dòng của mỗi đoạn liền nhau (Keep lines together).
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “What Cannot Be Recycled?” section, turn off widow/orphan control for the two paragraphs after the heading and keep the lines of each paragraph together.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn hai đoạn.  2) Home > Paragraph dialog > Line and Page Breaks: bỏ Widow/Orphan control; tích Keep lines together > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the two paragraphs.  2) Home > Paragraph dialog > Line and Page Breaks: clear Widow/Orphan control; check Keep lines together > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “What Cannot Be Recycled?” section, turn off widow/orphan control for the two paragraphs after the heading and keep the lines of each paragraph together.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Tạo bộ theme colors tùy chỉnh tên “Recycle Colors”, dùng màu Orange (Standard Colors) làm màu Accent 1.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Create a custom theme color set named “Recycle Colors” that uses Orange (Standard Colors) as the Accent 1 color.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Design > Colors > Customize Colors.  2) Accent 1: chọn Orange trong Standard Colors.  3) Name: Recycle Colors > Save.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Design > Colors > Customize Colors.  2) Accent 1: choose Orange under Standard Colors.  3) Name: Recycle Colors > Save.

cham.de_bai: Create a custom theme color set named “Recycle Colors” that uses Orange (Standard Colors) as the Accent 1 color.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đánh dấu tài liệu là bản cuối (Mark as Final).
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Mark the document as final.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: File > Info > Protect Document > Mark as Final > OK > OK.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: File > Info > Protect Document > Mark as Final > OK > OK.

cham.de_bai: Mark the document as final.
